messages:
zoe: hi team — Zoe here, started today on infra. I'm trying to get console admin for staging and prod plus LaunchDarkly flags-admin. In Okta I only see Console (reader). what's the usual path?

sam: welcome! :tada: For staging we usually grant via the 'console-admin-staging' group in Okta (self-serve). Prod is stricter: manager approval + security review. If the staging group isn't visible, open ENG-IT and tag me. DM me your manager and ill queue staging now.

maria: also double-check you completed the Data & Prod Access training in the People Ops portal — that's required for prod roles. Prod role name is `console-admin`, LD role is `flags-admin`.

zoe: I completed the training during onboarding. how do I request LaunchDarkly access?

ld-admin: send @sam your LD username and a short justification + expiry (we default 30 days for new hires). Example justification: "Project: infra rollout; Need: toggle infra flags during migration; Expiry: 2024-09-01"

henry: if you're flipping flags that touch traffic, include a short rollout/rollback plan in the ticket and prefer canary steps. Also add a kill-switch flag and monitoring metrics.

zoe: can someone paste a minimal ENG-IT ticket body I can copy?

sam: sure — copy/paste this into ENG-IT ticket: 

Request: console-admin-prod and flags-admin (LaunchDarkly)
Reason: <brief purpose>
Manager: <manager name>
Requested expiry: <YYYY-MM-DD>
Flags: <flag1, flag2>
Rollout plan: <canary %, metrics to watch, rollback criteria>

maria: FYI: to preview flags locally use rdwctl: `rdwctl flags get my_flag --env=staging --whoami` — helps validate the flag state before toggling.

onboarding-bot: reminder — new hires must enable 2FA and register a YubiKey for prod admin grants. Setup link: https://okta.redwood/setup-2fa

security-bot: note: all prod admin grants are audited weekly. please include the ENG-IT ticket number and scope justification (least privilege). security will run access checklist post-approval.

zoe: thanks everyone — opening the ENG-IT ticket now and will ping @sam once it's up. appreciate the help!:heart:
